title: refactor(ci): consolidate Node workflows, upgrade to Node 18, and standardize release automation
author: Ava Chen
description:
Motivation: Our repo has accumulated multiple near-duplicate GitHub workflows for lint/test/build/release across services. This increases maintenance burden and leads to subtle drift (different node versions, cache keys, and release semantics). This PR consolidates CI authoring into two reusable composite pieces and standardizes Node to 18.x across workflows. It also extracts release steps into a single composite action that the monorepo and SDK repos can reuse.

What this does (summary): - Add .github/actions/ci-common: composite action that centralizes checkout, setup-node (Node 18), cache (npm/yarn), dependency install and common env setup. - Add .github/actions/release: composite action that handles changelog generation, release tagging, and optionally uploads artifacts; supports a dry-run mode. - Replace multiple workflow copies (.github/workflows/*) with lightweight workflows that call the composites: ci.yml, lint.yml, release.yml. - Upgrade CI runners to node-version: 18.x and consolidate cache keys to include repo and workspace hash to avoid collisions. - Improve build caching logic to prefer restore-on-failure keys and add fallbacks for matrix OS differences. - Small dev-deps bump in package.json for eslint and typescript to align with repo lint config.

Developer notes: - Kept all functional behaviour the same; migration is authoring-only with a single integration test run to validate. - Kept release composite opt-in; existing repos must switch their workflows to use it (follow-up docs in RFC linked below). - There is a brief transient CI failure on macOS matrix due to an installation order; fixed in a follow-up commit in this PR.

Files touched (high level): - .github/actions/ci-common/action.yml - .github/actions/release/action.yml - .github/workflows/ci.yml (small wrapper) - .github/workflows/lint.yml (small wrapper) - .github/workflows/release.yml (small wrapper) - package.json (devDependencies) - .github/README-actions.md (docs for composites)

Small illustrative snippets included inline in commit messages: - ci-common/action.yml (excerpt): "runs: - uses: actions/checkout@v4\n- uses: actions/setup-node@v4 with: node-version: '18' cache: 'npm'" - release/action.yml (excerpt): "inputs: dry_run: description: 'Run release in dry-run mode' required: false default: 'true' runs: using: 'composite'"

CI/QA notes: - First CI run on draft failed on a macOS package installer order (npm ci vs. pnpm restore) — hidden by matrix differences; resolved by a commit that normalizes install ordering in ci-common. - After fixes, full CI matrix: build/test/lint passed. - Release dry-run executed successfully in the repo to verify tagging/notes generation.

Related: ENG-5821 (CI consolidation), ENG-5922 (release automation), see linked RFC in Linear for rollout plan.
commits: Initial composite actions + wrappers: add ci-common and release composites
Fix: normalize install ordering to address macOS matrix installer failure
Docs: add README for composites and migration guide
chore: bump eslint/typescript devDeps to align with action images
review_comments: Marcus Hill: Overall looks great — can we add a job timeout and a circuit breaker env var to the release composite?
Ava Chen: Added 'RELEASE_TIMEOUT' and 'RELEASE_DRY_RUN' inputs to the composite in the latest commit
Ravi Patel: Noticed cache key collision possibility on windows runners; suggested include runner.os and hash. Updated in commit 2
Sofia Martinez: Approved after the install-order fix and small docs addition — left a couple of nit comments on README wording
release_notes: Consolidated CI workflows into reusable composite actions, upgraded CI Node to 18.x, standardized caching strategy, and added a reusable release composite. No runtime changes. Repositories should migrate to the new composites to reduce CI maintenance.
